verdict.rationale: Productboard's integrations page names Zendesk and advertises importing sales and support conversations and importing messages containing feedback, so native feedback-capture connectors exist. Coverage is not complete: no specific sales tool (e.g., a CRM) is named as a native feedback source, and chat capture is only implied by a bare Microsoft Teams listing. The REST API route for CRMs is a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: named native sales/CRM feedback connectors, documented chat-tool feedback capture (Slack/Teams message-to-feedback), per-integration setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect feedback capture to support, sales, and chat tools I already use
